before_times: the service, and for color: the natural color and length now
any color, box dye, henna or bleach in the last 2 years
for a big change (2 or more levels lighter, a first balayage or highlights): a consult first
for a bridal party: how many people, and the date
after_time: anything the stylist should know (thick or long hair, a style to keep)
for a house call or venue: the address, parking and a room with a chair, light and a plug
secure_page_only: scalp sore, irritated or broken now
goal photos and photos of the hair now
intake_questions.who_may_book: an adult; a parent or guardian for anyone under 18 (and a parent's OK for color or chemical services on a minor where the state's rules require it)

stop.words: a dye reaction happening now: face, lips or throat swelling, hard to breathe
stop.say: Call 911 now. Rinse the dye off with plenty of water.

stop.words: a burn or blisters on the scalp after a chemical service
stop.say: Rinse with cool water and see a doctor today. The salon is told at once.
stop.booking: no booking until a doctor says it's OK

go_on.words: scalp irritated, sunburned, cut or infected
go_on.what: no color, relaxer or other chemical on it; the stylist checks the scalp and the patch-test spot before mixing; the visit goes on as a cut, or moves at no fee

safety_and_stop_words.always: the generic screen: danger to life, fire, gas, a medical emergency → call 911, and no booking

steps.name: Patch test (a small skin test for a reaction to hair dye)
steps.when: at least 48 hours before permanent color, the time the product label sets
steps.who: new color clients, and anyone whose last test has run out
steps.goodFor: 3 months (the example salon's rule), or until the product line changes
steps.result: the customer reports the spot on the secure page 48 hours after; redness or itching calls the color off with a full refund; no answer: the stylist checks the spot in the chair

steps.name: Consult and patch test
steps.when: at least 48 hours before a big change (2 or more levels lighter, a first balayage or highlights)
steps.result: the stylist sets the final price; the customer says yes, or cancels with a full refund

steps.name: Consult for color correction
steps.result: priced at the chair; often 2 or more visits

steps.name: Bridal hair trial
steps.when: before the wedding day (the owner's setting)
steps.result: the look and the timing for the day are saved for the stylist

first_steps_and_forms.prep: for the reminder: bring goal photos; tell the salon on the secure page about any change to the scalp; for a house call, a chair near a plug and good light

staff.skills: cut, color, extensions, bridal and updos, makeup; only stylists who do color are offered for color
staff.licenses_or_certificates: each stylist's license per state; makeup where the state licenses it
staff.supervision: apprentices and students work only under a licensed stylist, where the state's rules allow
staff.who_oks: Sam OKs every color quote, new-client color of 3 hours or more, and a past dye reaction
staff.stand_in: a stand-in gets the consult notes, the color formula and the patch-test date

children_and_age.who_may_book: an adult; a parent or guardian for anyone under 18 (and a parent's OK for color or chemical services on a minor where the state's rules require it)
children_and_age.minors_texts: a minor's booking texts go to the parent or guardian
children_and_age.minors_rules: a parent's written OK for chemical services on a minor, where the state's rules require it

visit.check_in: at the salon: the check-in code at the front desk or the chair; at a home or venue: the code from whoever will be there (the bride or the venue contact when a mobile is given for them)
visit.done: the check-in code, or DONE from the stylist; the color formula and photos go in the stylist's notes for next time
visit.changes_at_visit: extra work (a toner, a treatment, a bang trim) is priced and OK'd before it's done; long color is booked as one whole block, with processing time
visit.before_work: the stylist checks the scalp and the patch-test spot before mixing color, and goes over any price set at a consult or from photos before work starts

license.note: Optional. Upload anything. Rosie never checks it and never shows it as checked (D96).
license.need: always: hair work (cosmetology or hairstyling) is licensed where the state's rules require it
license.who: both: the salon holds a salon license, and each stylist holds their own
license.ask: the salon's license number; each stylist's number in their invite reply (or the owner sends it)
license.insurance: liability insurance where the state's form asks for it

never_in_a_text: allergy, dye-reaction, patch-test and scalp answers never go in a text or through the AI: only the secure page and the customer's record
